## v0.5.31: DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 support and Task Agent model choice / 支持 DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 与任务 Agent 模型选择

Publishes [#394](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/394), [#354](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/354), [#386](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/386) and [#410](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/410)–[#412](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/412). Thanks to [@yz1128](https://github.com/yz1128) and [@iuuuuuuuu](https://github.com/iuuuuuuuu).

- Supports DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 (npm `next`) and 0.2.0-rc.2 (npm `latest`). On DSH 0.2.1, memory subagents (Save to memory, Memory Space writes, idle review, compaction, archiving, sync review) and **Check versions → Update** work again (#386).
- **Task Agent model** offers **Follow global**, the new **Follow the conversation** and **Custom** (#354).
- Git sync refuses to publish a Documents payload whose index disagrees with its bodies, and names the document (#394).
- Idle review and its task Agent carry one name everywhere (#410); unused code and stale documentation links are gone (#411, #412).

发布 [#394](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/394)、[#354](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/354)、[#386](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/386) 与 [#410](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/410)–[#412](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/412)。感谢 [@yz1128](https://github.com/yz1128) 与 [@iuuuuuuuu](https://github.com/iuuuuuuuu)。

- 支持 DSH 0.2.1-rc.1（npm `next`）与 0.2.0-rc.2（npm `latest`）。在 DSH 0.2.1 上，记忆子 Agent（存入记忆、记忆空间写入、空闲审查、压缩、归档与同步审查）和**检查版本 → 更新**恢复工作（#386）。
- **任务 Agent 模型**提供**跟随全局**、新增的**跟随会话**与**自定义**（#354）。
- Git 同步拒绝发布索引与正文不一致的项目档案内容，并指出是哪份档案（#394）。
- 空闲审查及其任务 Agent 全面统一命名（#410）；移除无人使用的代码与过时的文档链接（#411、#412）。

The Starter advances to **0.5.31** and Memory Spaces to **0.5.21**. The other 16 component versions are unchanged. Existing memory needs no migration. DSH 0.1.7, 0.2.0-rc.1 and the 0.2.1 alphas refuse this release: keep 0.5.30 there, or upgrade DSH first.

Starter 升至 **0.5.31**，记忆空间升至 **0.5.21**；其余 16 个组件版本不变，无需迁移已有记忆。DSH 0.1.7、0.2.0-rc.1 与 0.2.1 的 alpha 版本会拒绝安装本版本：请在这些版本上保留 0.5.30，或先升级 DSH。

On DSH 0.2.0-rc.2, use **Memory System → Status → Check versions → Update**, then restart DSH. On DSH 0.2.1-rc.1, 0.5.30's update stops with `already-installed`: quit DSH, install the exact version once, then start DSH again.

在 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 上，使用**记忆系统 → 状态 → 检查版本 → 更新**，然后重启 DSH。在 DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 上，0.5.30 的更新会停在 `already-installed`：请退出 DSH，安装一次精确版本，再启动 DSH。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.31
```

Independently maintained copies in the Profile also need `dsh-mnemon-source-memory-spaces@0.5.21`.

Profile 独立维护的副本也需更新到 `dsh-mnemon-source-memory-spaces@0.5.21`。
